title: params stripped, content kept
setup: browser watcher emitting browser.visit events; text field carries the URL text form (bridges/normalise.urlTextForm), payload.url carries the raw visit.
expected: youtube keeps v,t · google keeps q · localhost:7373 keeps path · Netflix trackId,tctx dropped; survivors sorted by name; payload.url untouched.

wrong.label: content-param-stripped
wrong.assert_absent: a per-domain content param (v, t, q, path) missing from the text form

wrong.label: tracking-kept
wrong.assert_absent: utm_*, gs_lp, sca_esv, ei, ved, trackId or tctx surviving in the text form

wrong.label: survivors-unsorted
wrong.assert_absent: surviving params in source order rather than sorted

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §5.3 SRC-01 · params stripped, content kept
